name: a wall of website mockups tiles behind a section word
looks: A dense tilted wall of small website screenshots fills the background, each in its own faint card, while a bold section word sits large in the foreground over them.
build: variant-stack-reveal, scaled up to a full wall: 12-16 small DOM cards in a 3D-tilted grid (slight perspective rotateX), each fading up with a tiny seeded delay; the HUD frame and section label persist over it.
sound: A soft overlapping cluster of quiet pops as the wall fills.
prompt: Fill the background with a dense, slightly tilted wall of small sample screenshots, each fading up with a tiny stagger, while a single bold section word sits large in the foreground. Use it to prove volume of work behind a simple category label.
